name: BotFullInfo

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this bot. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.

fields.name: active_usernames
fields.description: If non-empty, the list of all active usernames of the bot

fields.name: can_join_groups
fields.description: True, if the bot can be added to groups

fields.name: can_read_all_group_messages
fields.description: True, if privacy mode is disabled for the bot

fields.name: supports_guest_queries
fields.description: True, if the bot supports guest queries from chats it is not a member of

fields.name: supports_inline_queries
fields.description: True, if the bot supports inline queries

fields.name: inline_query_placeholder
fields.description: Placeholder for inline queries, which is shown in the input field after the bot's username; omitted if the default placeholder is used

fields.name: needs_inline_query_location
fields.description: True, if the bot requests the location of the user with every inline query

fields.name: can_connect_to_business
fields.description: True, if the bot can be connected to a user account to manage it

fields.name: has_main_web_app
fields.description: True, if the bot has a main Web App

fields.name: has_topics_enabled
fields.description: True, if the bot has forum topic mode enabled in private chats

fields.name: allows_users_to_create_topics
fields.description: True, if the bot allows users to create and delete topics in private chats

fields.name: has_topic_sidebar
fields.description: True, if topics in private chats with the bot are shown in a sidebar

fields.name: can_manage_bots
fields.description: True, if other bots can be created to be controlled by the bot

fields.name: supports_join_request_queries
fields.description: True, if the bot supports join request queries and can be assigned to process them

description: This object contains full information about the bot itself.
